origin.source: TanStack Start API route bridging runAgent's streaming seams to TanStack AI's AG-UI wire protocol, consumed by a useChat client; a workspace package depending on real `@tanstack/ai` and `@tanstack/ai-react`, so CI catches API drift

comparison.purpose: Streaming a machine run to a UI: onChunk becomes TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT deltas, transitions become STEP_STARTED/STEP_FINISHED, and toServerSentEventsResponse serves it to an unmodified useChat client.
